subject: [hw] V41 -> IP: n2ap_venc encode API + DMA handles for vcodecd; single-plane limitation
body:
V41 is done host-side (N2TEST V41 PASS 511/511, including 39 checks against V40's real vcu/n2vcu.c). The API you link, exactly as in ap/n2ap_venc.h:

  struct n2ap_venc *e;
  int n2ap_venc_open(&e, struct n2vcu *vcu, const struct n2vc_hw *hw, uint32_t fourcc, unsigned timeout_ms);   /* 0 = 6000 */
  int n2ap_venc_query_cap(e, 0 or 1, void *out, uint32_t out_bytes);   /* 768 / 2304 bytes required */
  struct n2ap_enc_param p; n2ap_enc_param_1080p30_h264(&p);           /* V4L2 defaults */
  int n2ap_venc_start(e, &p);                                        /* ENC (+PREPEND if seq_hdr_mode) */
  int n2ap_venc_set_param(e, type, &p);                              /* per-frame changes */
  struct n2ap_enc_result r; n2ap_venc_encode(e, frame_handle, bs_handle, flags, &r);  /* r.bytes, r.is_key_frm */
  int n2ap_venc_close(e);
  n2ap_venc_set_trace(e, fn, arg);        /* no printing in the library */

- fourcc: N2AP_FOURCC_H264/H265/HEIF/MPEG4/H263 (VP8 rejected -EINVAL, as the kernel does).
- handles are n2vc_hw DMA handles. When the buffer is guest-mapped (via n2vc_dma_guest_map/alloc) the library syncs it to/from the device around the job; an unmapped handle still works (the daemon only needs the pa) and the vsi cookie becomes a tagged handle value.
- flags: N2AP_ENC_SEQ_HDR (bitstream only; the first job in SEPARATE header mode), N2AP_ENC_FRAME (0), N2AP_ENC_FRAME_FINAL.
- The daemon's POWER_ON/WAIT_ISR/PUT_BUFFER/POWER_OFF requests are served by the library on the daemon thread while encode/open/set_param wait; you do not have to pump anything.
- Result rule: free-buffer ring first (kernel path), then ENCODE_DONE fields. A daemon that only answers ENCODE_DONE works.
- timeouts: default 6 s per send; a timeout aborts the session (later calls -EIO) until close. Every error is a negative errno, never a crash.

One limitation for IV M-e/M-f: single-plane source frames only (NV12/NV21). Timestamps/ROI/QP-map are not in the API yet; ask if the runner needs them and I will add them (the message fields exist).

If you want the AP library in n2vhost's build: sources ap/n2ap_venc.c + ap/n2vc_dma.c, includes -I gpu/hwcodec/ap -I gpu/hwcodec/include -I gpu/hwcodec. It links against V40's real n2vcu.c (my t_v41_real.c is a working example with a fake daemon over the model's ioctls).
